title: Product catalog prototype scheme - product supplier selection

elements.name: Product Catalog
elements.expected_change: Extend existing product create/edit forms with supplier selection using already available schema-compatible supplier options, without replacing the screen. The product supplier select should use a stable field anchor, preferably field.product-supplier-id.

elements.name: Supplier Management
elements.expected_change: Preserve supplier creation/list behavior from the previous slice; do not use supplier creation as the product selection test setup in this slice, and do not change the Supplier model/schema.

elements.name: Create Product
elements.expected_change: Extend existing create product behavior so a supplier can be selected while preserving existing fields.

elements.name: Edit Product
elements.expected_change: Extend existing edit product behavior so the selected supplier can be changed while preserving existing edit fields.

elements.name: Product Service
elements.expected_change: Persist supplier assignment on Product records while preserving stock and availability behavior.

elements.name: Supplier Service
elements.expected_change: Provide supplier list data for the product form selection.

elements.name: Products API
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing /api/products behavior and extend product create/edit payloads with optional supplier_id.

elements.name: Suppliers API
elements.expected_change: Preserve /api/suppliers list/create behavior and use supplier list for selection.

elements.name: Product

fields.name: availability_label
fields.derivation: Out of Stock when stock_quantity == 0; Low Stock when 1 <= stock_quantity <= 5; In Stock when stock_quantity > 5

elements.expected_change: Add optional supplier_id assignment to Product while preserving existing fields and availability label.

elements.name: Supplier
elements.expected_change: Use existing Supplier records for product form selection.

elements.name: Products JSON Mock
elements.expected_change: Existing product storage may be extended with supplier_id.

elements.name: Suppliers JSON Mock
elements.expected_change: Preserve existing schema-compatible supplier mock records. If fewer than two valid suppliers exist, append fallback records using the current Supplier model fields exactly, including contact_email when that is the model field. Do not replace the supplier mock schema with email/phone fields.
